<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1051
Claimant:
Tammy Barrett
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
2024-08-28
Claim opened after the insured's vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection. The claimant reports a back
strain and says the impact was sudden and forceful.
2024-09-05
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at the time
of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
2024-09-08
Police report and the statements of the scene witnesses place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact.
The witnesses did not see the collision itself, so there are no independent eyewitnesses to the sequence of events.
2024-09-26
Photographs taken at the scene show the damage to the vehicle, and the pattern of damage lines up with the impact
described by the claimant. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection notes.
2024-10-03
Spoke with the claimant by phone. The account of how the collision happened was the same as the one given at first
notice, with no changes in the sequence or the details.
2024-11-25
The claimant's injury report fits the type and force of the crash. Medical records show the claimant was treated for a
complaint in the same area of the back within the last two years, and that prior condition is adding to the current
symptoms.
2024-12-02
Treatment followed a typical course, with early visits for pain and stiffness and then a gradual reduction in
appointments as the claimant improved. The provider's notes describe steady recovery.
2025-01-12
Second call with the claimant confirmed the same account of the collision, again without any variation. The claimant is
not represented by an attorney and has been handling communications directly.
2025-03-28
File reviewed and summarized for the supervisor. Vehicle damage, injury type, and treatment pattern are consistent
with the reported loss, with the prior back condition noted as a factor in the current complaints.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
